name: Wickgate Glade
description: The arrival clearing: a lantern tree, stone lanterns and the wayboard of signs to every place.

name: Lanternwrights Hollow
description: A hamlet of lantern makers: cottages with lit windows, a workshop, a well and racks of lanterns.

name: The Hollow Oak
description: A giant oak whose trunk you can walk through, lanterns hung inside and a ring of glowcaps.

name: Candlestone Circle
description: Nine standing stones and an altar, each with its own cluster of candles.

name: Glowmoss Dell
description: A sunken hollow of luminous moss, glowing mushrooms and drifting fireflies.

name: Beacon Hill
description: The forest's high point, crowned by a stepped beacon and a watch spire above the fog.

name: Mirrormist Tarn
description: A dark still lake with floating lanterns, a jetty, a boathouse and a lantern island.
